title: Stock Market Update: AI and Chip Stocks Face Pressure
description: Recent reports indicate stock futures are dropping as the chip rally loses steam. AI and chip stocks are experiencing profit-taking, with specific companies seeing declines in pre-market trading.

sections.heading: Market Movements
paragraphs: According to Barron's, stock futures are dropping as the chip rally runs out of steam. Additionally, marketscreener.com reports that AI and chip stocks are suffering from profit-taking.

sections.heading: Pre-Market Stock Performance
paragraphs: TradingKey reports that the AI chip and storage sectors are under pressure. Specific movements include Nvidia falling nearly 2%, Marvell dropping over 6%, and SanDisk slumping over 5%.
